headline: Fed Meeting, Inflation, Boeing, Meta, Apple, Exxon, and More to Watch This Week
summary: This is a huge earnings week, with nearly a third of S&P 500 companies reporting. The Fed is expected to hold rates steady after its confab ends Wednesday, and we’ll see key inflation data on Thursday.
